breakdown.description: Simulation is inviscid but Sutherland viscosity is enabled. Do not use Sutherland viscosity for inviscid flow

It explicitly added the instruction "Do not use Sutherland viscosity" and further clarified to "Set dynamic viscosity to zero or an effectively zero constant value... to represent inviscid flow," which is the correct approach.
